style: Say curiously and warmly, like a friendly school librarian
lines: Pick a die, then press Roll once. Every 1 is a decay.
Watch the ringed die. Its chance stays the same, no matter how long it lasts.
Pick a card. Set the missing mass number and charge, then press Check.
Pick a sample. Drag the ruler pin, press Estimate, then press Calculate.
That one's past the clock's range. Too little carbon-14 left.
Watch the tray finish this roll. Reset can start a fresh tray.
Watch Average 20 runs finish. Press Reset for a fresh tray.
The ringed die decayed. Press Track one to choose another live die.
Drag the line to 500, then read the roll number. Arrow keys move by 25 nuclei.
Every roll is done. Press Reset for a fresh tray.
Watch the ringed die beside the crowd. Press Roll once to test its unchanged chance.
Compare energy per event on the ladder. Pick another card to balance its missing product.
Fix the sum that is off, then press Check again.
Watch the model counter finish, then drag the ruler pin and press Estimate.
Compare your estimate with the calculation. Pick another sample or switch Counting noise.
Your estimate is recorded. Press Calculate to see the logarithm steps.
Press Reset to track a die from the start.
Roll first, then mark the half-life.
Press Estimate first to record your moved ruler pin, then press Calculate.
Watch the model counter finish. Then press Calculate to compare this count with your recorded estimate.
The line is on 500. Press Roll once until your tray crosses it.
Compare your tray with the exact value. Press Average 20 runs to see the crowd settle.
